concept.material: polished grey soapstone and nickel silver
concept.internal_detail: intricate brass sliding linkages and miniature counterweights
concept.button: a small nickel pin set flush into the grey surface
concept.button_short: the small nickel pin on the flank
concept.shell_mechanic: The soapstone upper casing slides backward on polished internal tracks and splits down its central seam
concept.emerging_parts: Four short jointed legs and a tapered tail section
concept.signature_move: its jointed steel head pivots toward the camera on its neck pin with a small click, and one front leg lifts on its hinge and sets down again like a single clockwork step
concept.turkish: Benekli semender (nemli ormanlarda yasayan, kuyruklu amfibi) — kavisli nehir tasi, parlak gri sabun tasi ve nikel gumus

concept.material: hand-blown quartz crystal and gold-plated brass
concept.internal_detail: fine gold hairsprings and microscopic steel pivots
concept.shell_mechanic: The hexagonal crystal splits along three vertical seams and the casing panels slide outward
concept.emerging_parts: Four transparent mica wings, six segmented gold legs, and a striped abdomen
concept.signature_move: its four mica wings vibrate rapidly on their hinge pins with a high-pitched metallic hum
concept.turkish: Bal arisi (ciceklerden nektar toplayan bocek) — yuzeyli altigen silindir, el yapimi kuvars kristali ve altin kaplama pirinc
